brand.name: Rafid
brand.tagline: Smart financing for your business, built on your data

hero.headline: Smart financing for your business, built on your data
hero.subheadline: Connect your bank and sales platforms and receive Sharia-compliant Murabaha funding against your confirmed receivables — with a transparent, explainable credit assessment.

step1.title: Connect your accounts
step1.body: Rafid aggregates 90 days of your bank and sales-platform data via open banking, with your consent.

step2.title: Transparent credit score
step2.body: The Rafid engine scores your creditworthiness with a transparent, explainable model — with clear reasons behind every decision.

step3.title: Murabaha that repays itself
step3.body: Receive Murabaha cash against your confirmed receivables, with repayment auto-collected from your incoming settlements.

disclaimer.text: Demo dataset for presentation purposes only — not real bank accounts.

register.title: Create your Rafid account
register.subtitle: Connect your accounts and see what you qualify for — in minutes.

connect.title: Connect your accounts
connect.subtitle: Rafid reads 90 days of your bank and sales data to assess you. You stay in control — revoke any time.
connect.pickBankHint: We read balances and transactions to understand your cash flow.
connect.pickPlatformHint: We read orders and settlements — the receivables your financing is based on.
connect.scopeOrders: Read your orders from the last 90 days
connect.scopeSettlements: Read your pending and past settlements
connect.scopeRevoke: Revoke this access at any time from Settings
connect.consentDemoNote: Demo environment — this connects to a simulated provider, not a real bank.
connect.aggregateBody: Pull the last 90 days from every connected source so we can assess you.
connect.doneBody: Here's what we imported from your connected accounts.

settings.title: Settings
settings.connectionsHint: Revoking a source stops it contributing to future assessments.
settings.noConnections: You haven't connected any accounts yet.
settings.revokeBody: Rafid will stop reading data from {institution}, and it won't count toward future assessments.

engine.confidenceHint: How much data stands behind this assessment — separate from the score itself.
engine.factorsHint: Each factor's share of your score, and whether it helped or held you back.
engine.repaymentHint: Indicative projection — collected automatically from your upcoming settlements. Your final terms appear on the offer.

state.errorBody: The server didn't respond as expected.
state.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

login.title: Sign in to Rafid
login.subtitle: Access your financing dashboard.
login.demoLabel: Or jump straight into a demo account

dashboard.heldHint: Cash you can unlock today — financing is a percentage of this amount.
dashboard.onboardBody: Rafid needs your bank and sales data before it can assess you. It takes about a minute.
dashboard.revenueHint: Completed orders across all connected sales platforms.

financing.title: Financing
financing.introBody: Run a transparent credit assessment on your 90 days of connected data. It takes a second, and you'll see exactly what drives the decision.
financing.underReviewBody: Your assessment sits just outside automatic approval, so a bank underwriter is reviewing it. You'll see their decision — and any note they leave — here.
financing.acceptedToast: Offer accepted. Your cash advance is on its way.
financing.murabahaNote: Sharia-compliant Murabaha — the bank buys at cost and sells at cost plus a disclosed profit. No interest.
